answer: Behavioral lineage tracing. Log each agent's action sequence and compute pairwise overlap of rare action n-grams across alleged-independent accounts; a rising tide of shared overlap flags a cluster. Enforcement: freezing the cluster's payouts and queuing its members for manual review. An attacker pays to fabricate genuinely distinct behavior per identity, since any dune of duplicated rare sequences links the whole set and forfeits it. The signal is retrospective, so upfront sybil waves still get caught after the fact.
